name: Keibiin 2
source:
Main character gets a security guard job at a huge mall. Security system is fully electronic, so only two guards are enough to maintain it. Protagonist's partner can not handle computers, so protagonist gets full authority of using this system in his malicious intents.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在一家大型购物中心找到了一份保安工作。安全系统是全电子化的，因此只需两名警卫就足以维护它。主角的搭档不会操作电脑，因此主角完全有权使用该系统来进行恶意操作。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
